content.short: Safary is a research and attribution community bringing decision-making knowledge to growth managers.
content.description: Safary equips growth teams with clear insights into channel long-term value, the evolving user base, and key target segments within Web3. It provides actionable metrics to evaluate the viability of market segments when budgeting for growth initiatives, helping allocate resources more effectively. Community managers can study strategies and reuse budgets or segments for their own projects, accelerating informed decision-making without guesswork.
